name: Arthur George Bainbridge West
bio: E. P. Warren's first choice of life-companion, before John Marshall. On a trip to Wiesbaden and Rome in 1889 Warren confided his wish to share his life with 'an alter ego'; West, long set on Holy Orders, was not happy with the possible implications and declined. Warren remained devoted to him regardless, becoming godfather to his sons; West's son Charles Murray West later ran Warren's house in Maine and inherited it.
